title: Which take of each story-night sound to keep
question: Each animation the sleep plays now has sound under it, and the boot bloom has a chime. Five sounds are wired: a peck for the crow's strikes; treads, a servo and a seed scatter for the robot; and a soft rising chime under the bloom. Four of the five are free recordings (CC0); the chime is synthesized, because no free bell recording rises in pitch and the moment needs a rise. Every sound has alternates already in the game. Below, each sound is shown as the same moment recorded from the running game once per candidate, with only that one sound changed and everything else at the picks, so the pick sits beside what it beat. Turn the sound on. The first video is all five picks in one pass.
why_now: The sounds ship with the story nights. Whatever you pick here is what players hear on the first crow night.

options.label: Keep the five picks as wired (Recommended)

options.detail: Say which sound and which alternate in your comment (for example: chime, alternate 2). Each alternate is already in the game and in the credits, so a swap is one line.

options.label: None of these for one of the sounds
options.detail: Say which sound in your comment and what it should feel like instead. Dmitri sources or synthesizes another round for that one.

ruled.summary: The peck and the chime stay (the chime with a longer pause before the music ramps); the treads become mehackit robot 5 timed to the drive; the servo alternates Servo 7 and Servo 9; the scatter is any.
ruled.judgment:
Crow's peck: I agree with recommendation, and everything is perfect.
For robot's treads: I like mehackit robot 5, but we have to time the audio to match the visuals
For robot's servo, I think we should alternate between servo 7 and servo 9.
For seed scatter, they all sound about the same to me so any are good.
For chime under the bloom, I'm good with the recommendation. Please add a bit more pause after that synthesized chime finishes before we ramp into the main game's music?
